items.title: Scientists are using Google AI to help restore giant kelp forests.
items.content: Underwater forests of giant kelp protect coastlines, provide habitat, and support marine ecosystems — but they’re disappearing worldwide due to ocean warming. As COP31 k…
items.contentSnippet: Underwater forests of giant kelp protect coastlines, provide habitat, and support marine ecosystems — but they’re disappearing worldwide due to ocean warming. As COP31 k…

summaries.zh: 科学家正利用谷歌人工智能技术帮助恢复巨藻林。这些海底森林为海岸提供保护、创造栖息地并支持海洋生态系统，但全球正因海水变暖而逐渐消失。在COP31会议期间，该技术被应用于恢复项目。
summaries.en: Scientists are employing Google AI to aid in the restoration of giant kelp forests, which protect coastlines, provide habitat, and support marine ecosystems. These forests are declining globally due to ocean warming. The AI technology is being utilized to monitor and analyze environmental data, helping to identify optimal conditions for kelp regrowth and inform conservation efforts.
